instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width, ground through all four corners, engage thighs, and lengthen the crown of your head toward the sky.
Fold from the hips, soften the knees as needed, let the crown release toward the floor, and breathe into the back body.
From a forward fold, lengthen the spine forward, press palms into shins, and draw shoulders away from ears.
Sit hips back as if into a chair, keep knees over ankles, lift arms alongside ears, and engage the core.
Step one foot back, ground through the heel, square hips forward, bend the front knee, and reach arms overhead.
Open the hips toward the long edge of the mat, stack front knee over ankle, extend arms in opposite directions, and gaze past front fingertips.
Shift weight onto the front leg, hinge forward, extend the lifted leg back in one line with the torso, and reach arms forward or back.
From Warrior II, flip the front palm upward, keep the lunge, and arc the torso back as the back hand glides down the back leg.
Plant front elbow on thigh or hand to floor, extend top arm overhead, and lengthen from heel through fingertips.
Straighten the front leg, hinge at the hip, reach forward, and rotate chest open while the bottom hand rests on shin or block.
Balance on the standing leg, open hips to the side, reach the top arm skyward, and keep the lifted leg parallel to the floor.
Step the back heel high, bend the front knee to 90 degrees, lift the torso, and reach arms overhead while lengthening through the spine.
Lower the back knee to the mat, sink hips forward, keep the front knee over ankle, and draw the shoulder blades down the back.
Frame the front foot with both hands, press the back heel long, and extend through the crown of the head while maintaining a strong core.
Square hips to the front, hinge over the front leg, keep the spine long, and use blocks under the hands for support.
Stand with feet wide, hinge at the hips, fold forward, and let the crown reach toward the floor while keeping weight in the balls of the feet.
Fold over the standing leg, lift the opposite leg high behind you, and draw the torso toward the thigh.
With hips squared, fold over the front leg and rotate the torso toward it, clasping opposite elbows or reverse prayer behind the back.
Clasp hands behind the back, bow inside the front thigh, and allow the arms to stretch overhead while keeping the front knee deeply bent.
Turn toes out, bend knees over ankles, sink hips down, and keep the spine tall as arms bend into cactus shape.
Take a wide stance, point toes slightly outward, bend knees deeply, tuck the tailbone slightly, and engage the core while hands rest at heart center.
Squat with feet slightly turned out, press elbows into inner knees, lengthen the spine, and broaden the chest.
Come onto forearms and knees wide, open ankles in line with knees, and gently press hips back to deepen the stretch.
From a low lunge, bring both hands inside the front foot, lower forearms to blocks or mat, and breathe into the back hip.
Bring the front shin forward, slide the back leg long, square the hips, and fold forward over the front leg while relaxing the shoulders.
Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, thread hands behind the lower thigh, and gently draw the legs toward the chest.
Stack knees on top of each other, sit on a block if needed, reach one arm overhead and the other behind the back to clasp or use a strap.
Sit tall, stack shins parallel like logs, flex both feet, and lean forward slightly to intensify the stretch.
Bring the soles of the feet together, let knees drop open, hold feet or ankles, and hinge forward from the hips.
Kneel with knees together, sit between the heels on the floor or block, and lengthen the spine while relaxing shoulders.
From Hero Pose, recline onto forearms and eventually back, supporting with bolsters if needed, and keep knees grounded.
Sit tall, extend legs forward, flex feet, reach through the arms, and fold from the hips with a long spine.
Sit with legs extended, press palms beside hips, lengthen the spine, and flex the feet while engaging the thighs.
Balance on the sit bones, lift shins parallel or extend legs, lengthen the spine, and reach arms forward.
Squat low, place palms shoulder-width, shift weight forward onto triceps, lift feet off the ground, and engage the core.
Stack one foot over the other, press the supporting hand into the mat, lift hips, and reach the top arm skyward.
Stack shoulders over wrists, press the heels back, engage the core, and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Place forearms parallel, press elbows into the mat, tuck toes under, and create one long line from shoulders to heels.
From forearm plank, walk feet closer, lift hips high, and release the head between upper arms.
Press palms and feet into the mat, lift hips high, lengthen the spine, and gently pedal through the heels.
From tabletop, walk hands forward, melt chest toward the floor, and keep hips stacked over knees.
Sit back on heels, lower torso between thighs, extend arms forward, and rest forehead on the mat.
From tabletop, slide one arm underneath the other, rest the shoulder on the mat, and gently twist while extending the opposite arm overhead.
From tabletop, round the spine toward the ceiling, tuck chin to chest, and draw navel toward the spine.
From tabletop, drop the belly, lift the tailbone and heart, and gently gaze forward.
Alternate between arching and rounding the spine with the breath, moving fluidly between Cat and Cow.
Lie on your belly, place elbows under shoulders, press forearms down, and lift the chest while keeping lower body relaxed.
Press tops of feet into the mat, engage legs, lift the chest using back strength, and keep elbows close to the ribs.
Straighten arms, lift thighs and knees off the mat, broaden the collarbones, and gaze slightly upward.
Lie on your belly, interlace fingers behind you, lift the chest and legs off the mat, and draw shoulder blades together.
Bend knees, reach back for ankles, kick feet into hands, lift chest and thighs, and lengthen through the front body.
Kneel with hips over knees, place hands on heels or lower back, press hips forward, and lift through the heart.
Lie on your back, bend knees, press feet and arms into the mat, lift hips, and interlace fingers beneath you.
Lie on your back, place palms beside ears, press into hands and feet, and lift hips and chest into an arch.
Lie on your back, prop on forearms, puff the chest, and gently release the crown of the head toward the mat.
Lie supine, lift legs overhead, place hands on the low back, stack hips over shoulders, and keep gaze upward.
From Shoulderstand, lower toes toward the floor behind the head, interlace fingers, and breathe into the back body.
Scoot hips close to a wall, extend legs up, relax arms by the sides, and soften the breath.
Lie on back, bend knees toward armpits, hold outer feet, and gently rock side to side.
Lie back with soles of feet together, place blocks or pillows under knees if desired, and rest hands on belly and heart.
Lie on back, draw one knee across the body, extend opposite arm to the side, and gaze toward the extended hand.
Draw both knees to chest, extend arms wide, drop knees to one side, and keep both shoulders grounded.
Lie comfortably on your back, let feet fall open, rest arms with palms up, close eyes, and relax completely.
Root one foot, place the other foot on the inner calf or thigh, engage the standing leg, and bring palms together at heart or overhead.
Wrap one arm under the other, cross one leg over the standing leg, sit back, and lift elbows in line with shoulders.
Shift weight to one foot, catch the opposite foot with the same-side hand, press foot into hand, and reach the free arm forward.
From Dancer Pose, deepen the backbend by drawing the lifted foot closer to the head and keeping hips squared.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, sit back into an imaginary chair, keep chest lifted, and engage the core.
Stand tall, interlace fingers overhead, lengthen through the spine, and lean gently to one side while grounding through both feet.
Sit low into Chair Pose, bring palms to heart, twist toward one side, and hook the opposite elbow outside the knee.
Step into Crescent Lunge, bring palms together, twist toward the front leg, and hook elbow outside the knee while keeping hips level.
Square hips, hinge forward, plant opposite hand outside the front foot, and rotate the chest toward the front leg while reaching the top arm upward.
From a lunge, hook opposite elbow outside the front knee, extend the back heel long, and lengthen from crown through back foot.
Fold forward with feet wide, place one hand beneath the face, reach the other arm skyward, and rotate the spine.
Bend one knee deeply, extend the opposite leg, flex the extended foot, and keep the spine long while palms press at heart or reach forward.
From Triangle, wrap the top arm behind the back to clasp the inner thigh and open the chest further toward the sky.
In Puppy Pose, thread one arm underneath to add a twist, then switch sides to balance the shoulders.
From Camel, tuck toes, lengthen through the front body, and reach one arm overhead while the opposite hand stays on the heel.
Lift into Bridge, extend one leg toward the ceiling, keep hips level, and breathe steadily before switching sides.
Lie over a bolster or block placed under the upper back, let head rest on another support, and allow arms to drape open.
Extend one leg, bend the other foot inside the thigh, reach opposite arm overhead toward the extended foot, and twist the chest skyward.
Extend one leg straight, place the other foot inside the thigh, and fold over the extended leg while keeping the spine long.
Sit with legs wide, flex the feet, hinge forward from the hips, and walk hands along the floor.
Sit cross-legged, place one hand on the floor, reach the other arm overhead, and arc gently to the side while keeping both sit bones grounded.
Cross one leg over the other, lengthen the spine, hook opposite elbow outside the knee, and twist toward the back hand.
Bend one knee close to the chest, wrap opposite arm around the shin, and rotate the torso toward the bent knee.
Kneel on one knee, extend the other leg to the side, reach the same-side arm overhead, and stretch toward the extended leg.
From Camel Pose, reach one arm across the body to the opposite heel, extend the other arm skyward, and rotate the chest.
From Dolphin Pose, walk feet closer, shift shoulders over elbows, and practice small hops to build strength.
Place feet on a wall in an L shape, stack shoulders over wrists, and engage the core to stabilize.
Stand tall, lift one leg, grab the big toe with same-side hand, and extend the leg forward or to the side while engaging the core.
Cross ankles, hinge at the hips, fold forward, and let the head relax while grounding through the outer edges of the feet.
In Cow Pose, gently turn head side to side to release the neck while keeping shoulders away from ears.
Place elbows on a block, bring palms together, drop the head between arms, and breathe into the triceps and armpits.
Place forearms on the wall, step back to drop the chest, and gently press to open the shoulders.
From tabletop, rotate fingers to face knees, lean hips back, and keep palms flat to stretch forearms.
Place backs of hands on the mat with fingers pointing inward, slowly press palms toward the floor, and stop before discomfort.
Sit tall, drop right ear toward right shoulder, reach left arm to the side, and gently hold the head to deepen the stretch.
Lie on your back, interlace hands behind the head, lift head and shoulders slightly, and draw chin toward chest.
Sit with both legs to one side, root sitting bones evenly, wrap the opposite hand around the knee, and twist gently toward the back shoulder.
